articles.title: 伊姆兰·汗狱中称健康恶化，寻求紧急医疗
articles.summary: 巴基斯坦前总理伊姆兰·汗通过律师公开信件，称健康状况恶化、可能无法活着出狱，要求紧急治疗；巴政府称其在押期间获得医疗和设施。
articles.new_facts: 伊姆兰·汗通过律师公开信件称健康恶化并寻求紧急医疗；巴政府部长否认待遇不佳，称其获得全部设施；当局称其一周前接受眼部注射且临床稳定。
articles.limitations: 核心医疗说法来自伊姆兰·汗一方公开信件，由BBC报道，未获独立医疗评估证实；巴基斯坦政府否认部分说法。报道未提供信件全文或具体医疗记录。

facts.text: 据BBC报道，巴基斯坦前总理伊姆兰·汗通过律师公开信件，称自己与妻子健康状况持续恶化，要求紧急医疗救治。他写道，74岁的自己“可能无法活着回来”。

evidence.quote: Pakistan's jailed former PM Imran Khan has appealed for urgent medical treatment, saying that his and his wife's health has been deteriorating.
"At 74, this unrelenting state is taking me to a place from which I may not return alive," the cricket star-turned-politician wrote in a letter published by his lawyer Salman Safdar.

facts.text: 伊姆兰·汗称医生警告他面临脑出血和心脏骤停风险，心脏已受损；他还说被单独监禁每天长达22小时，过去一年只见过律师四次。

evidence.quote: In his letter, Khan wrote that doctors have told him he is "highly vulnerable to a brain haemorrhage and cardiac arrest", and that his heart has already "suffered damage".

He said that he is being held in solitary confinement for up to 22 hours a day, where he is allowed neither visits by his family nor access to books and television, and that this has "taken a heavy toll" on his mental health.
He also claimed he had only seen his lawyers four times over the past year.

facts.text: 巴基斯坦议会事务部长乔杜里否认上述说法，称汗在狱中获得包括自选食物在内的全部设施。巴当局还表示，汗一周前被送往政府医院接受眼部注射，医生认为其“临床稳定”。

evidence.quote: Pakistan's parliamentary affairs minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry disputed these claims, saying Khan is "provided with all facilities in prison, including food of his own choosing".
Authorities also say Khan was taken to a government-run hospital for an eye injection a week ago, where doctors deemed him "clinically stable".
